title: G20 Nations Publicly Reject US Position on Excess Industrial Capacity, Complicating Tariff Push
detail: A handful of G20 countries publicly rejected the US position on addressing excess industrial capacity at the summit, complicating Trump's tariff push on the international stage. The pushback underscores growing diplomatic resistance to Washington's trade agenda and signals that US tariff policy faces headwinds even among major allies and partners gathered at the G20.
